title: Unisex Outdoors – Went Outside. It Was Fine. Embroidered Zip Hoodie
who: the person who finally went outside and reports that it was fine, zipped on for the trailhead, the lake and the drive home.
art: A snowy mountain range with a sunrise starburst reflects in a still lake beside a lone canoe, with dark pines along the shore, in slate blue, rust, gold and cream with a worn print texture.
headline: WENT OUTSIDE.
inks: cream and gold on Black and Navy, forest green and navy on Ash
chest: a small pine tree with a sun behind it
warm2: cool trailheads, lakeside mornings and the drive home with the windows down
gift_line: for the friend who hikes for the view and reports back that it was fine.
seo_desc: An outdoorsy zip up hoodie: WENT OUTSIDE. IT WAS FINE. on the back over a mountain lake and canoe, plus an embroidered pine tree and sun on the chest.
